title: Implement psp-etl query CLI command (issue L2). Add to src/psp_etl/cli.py: 'query' subcommand with --gen (zen1-zen5), --type (hex type_id), --vendor, --min-score (float), --has-strings (flag), --string (pattern in strings table), --format (table/json/csv). Output must show human-readable columns: type_name, version, vendor, model, score — NO raw SHA-256 hashes in default table output. Support rich table, JSON, CSV formats. --string filters entries whose blobs contain matching strings. See DESIGN.md CLI Interface.
